headline: M2: the 100-case benchmark pool is assembled; ground-truth adjudication is next.
detail: M1 is complete. The M2 benchmark suitability target is now assembled and quality-reviewed at 100 suitable cases: 78 suitable cases from the original 100-case review plus 22 reviewed and accepted replacements for the 22 unsuitable originals. The historical-context evidence remains materialized and integrity-validated, with 820 unique historical records supporting 1,952 case-to-context relationships and all 820 evidence hashes verified. The remaining M2 gate is human context-sufficiency review, relationship ground-truth adjudication, schema validation, and benchmark v0.1 freeze. OpenAI Cybersecurity Grant application preparation is active in parallel and will use only verified preliminary evidence.
next_gate: Complete the 100 human context-sufficiency decisions, expand evidence only where MORE_CONTEXT_REQUIRED, then complete relationship ground-truth adjudication, schema validation, and freeze benchmark v0.1. Grant application preparation proceeds in parallel using verified evidence only.

schedule.note: The September 11 and September 18 dates are historical targets. The prior October 2 internal target is no longer treated as a reason to delay application preparation; submission is being advanced as soon as the proposal is sufficiently supported.

public_private_boundary: Only aggregate research-progress counts are public. Private evidence packets, historical-context evidence, raw operational records, and case-level decisions are not exposed by this status artifact.
